No APK required. The complete NightSweep app runs in your Android browser. You may keep using the browser tab or add a Home Screen icon. Both open the same web app.

1. Open the Android web app

  1. Open NightSweep in Chrome

    Tap Open NightSweep above. If the link opened inside a text, email, or social app, open its address in Chrome. Use a regular tab, not Incognito, for saved jobs.

  2. Wait for the offline copy

    On the app's Home tab, wait for Ready for offline use. You can use the calculators immediately while online; the ready message confirms that the software and guides were saved.

  3. Choose browser or Home Screen

    Keep the browser tab bookmarked to use NightSweep without installing anything. For an icon, tap Install app on Home when it appears. Otherwise use Chrome's ⋮ menu: Install and create shortcut → Install, or Add to Home screen → Install, depending on your Chrome version.

    Install from the actual app, not this instruction page. The browser decides whether an install prompt is available. A shortcut may open a browser tab instead of a separate window.

  4. Open your icon and check it

    If installed, open NightSweep from the new Home Screen icon while online. Confirm 1.8 Alpha build 2, then wait for the ready message there. Export and import a backup if your job is not present.

  5. Try the guided example

    Choose Home → Open complete training job and follow its 21 steps. Training data is labeled and is not a field measurement or acceptance limit.

2. Bring jobs from the APK

The APK and web app keep separate data. Opening the website cannot read the installed APK's saved jobs.

  1. In the APK, open each important job and choose Files → Save project. Complete the Android save dialog.
  2. Confirm the JSON backup is in My Files / Files → Downloads or the folder you selected.
  3. In the web app, choose Files → Open project or Open project backup, then select that JSON file.
  4. Check its name, route, notes and original evidence. For the separate ONX-630 reference job, use Files → Open project, then review Job → ONX files. Save a named job and keep the external backup.

Use one NightSweep window at a time. Each browser/profile and device may keep separate storage; Chrome and Samsung Internet do not automatically share jobs. There is no cloud job synchronization. Export before switching browsers, clearing website data, uninstalling, or changing phones.

The web app's Save/share file or Download file action still needs you to complete the phone's save flow. A prepared file is not yet a verified backup.

3. Check offline use and update

  1. Export real work, then open the training job for a practice check.
  2. After Ready for offline use, enable Airplane Mode and turn Wi-Fi off.
  3. Close and reopen NightSweep through the same browser or icon. Open a calculator and a saved attachment.
  4. Reconnect. For updates, choose Home → Check for updates, export your job, then choose Install update → Reload app.

The app does not reload an open job automatically. A failed update keeps the previous verified offline copy. Manufacturer reference links and files that exist only in a cloud drive still need a connection.

Use Protect local storage when offered. The browser decides whether to grant protection; exported project files remain necessary backups.

Common questions

Install app is missing.

You can use NightSweep in the browser now. Open the actual app in a regular Chrome tab and check Chrome's menu for Install and create shortcut or Add to Home screen. Menu wording and availability vary; managed phones may restrict installation.

I already have the APK. Which icon is which?

The APK is labeled NightSweep 1.8 Preview build 2. The web app uses NightSweep. Their job storage is separate. Export/import project backups when moving between them.

Can I open the HTML file directly?

The coworker ZIP includes NightSweep.html, the runnable single-file calculator. A browser that supports local HTML can open it without the APK. Android file viewers may block scripts, file imports, or persistent storage. For normal phone use, open the hosted web app; it offers verified offline caching and a consistent storage origin. A downloaded HTML file is not itself an installed offline web app.

The icon will not open offline.

Reconnect, open the same browser or icon and wait for Ready for offline use. Use Retry offline setup if offered. Export unsaved work before changing storage settings. Check the offline launch on your own phone before field work.

Google's Android web-app installation guide · iPhone instructions · Full technician README

Phone installation, file pickers and storage behavior need testing on your device. No APK, Google Play purchase or separate account is required to use the website.

Start at the actual launch output

In Route → Setup, choose Node output, Amplifier / LE output, or Manual / other output. Select the exact equipment and port, then enter actual launch levels and only the remaining test-point correction.

Choose Source setup & manual, or Route → Equipment setup, then continue to cable route, sweep, readings and evidence. Source selection does not automatically change your levels. Export a project before updating and verify saved work afterward.
